claim.body: Wallets with a qualifying buy and at least 10,000 fungible tokens can claim one MT/Soul NFT, capped at 2,100 MTs per token.

page.title: Release a living token
page.description: Name a 21M-token market, choose a visual world, and sign. Every 10,000 tokens can qualify one scarce MT/Soul NFT, up to 2,100 MTs.
page.lifecycleModelBody: SolSoul separates the market token from the collectible. A launch creates 21,000,000 fungible tokens on a forever curve; collecting one MT/Soul NFT requires a qualifying 10,000-token buy and current holder gate, with at most 2,100 MT/Soul NFTs per token. The launch fee supports operations, while a small buy fee stays with the market as durable backing.

dust.title: Liquidity dust components
dust.description: Decimal-string raw fields from bonding-curve reserves, historical/deferred liquidity-vault evidence when present, receipt binding lifecycle state, and auditable outside-liquidity scans. Values are displayed exactly as API strings.
dust.prototypeNotice: Transfer Hook prototype limitations and partial/stale source badges mean these metrics are source-backed where available. Wallet direct transfers are hook-aware; historical Raydium swap-path evidence remains bounded/deferred and is not part of the active curve-only product flow. The liquidity dust ratio is venue-local and not an official scarcity signal.
